text:
matt: kicking off onboarding for mjolnir-2 (opt-4b, fp16 trained). weights uploaded to s3://redwood-models/mjolnir/mjolnir-2/weights.tar.gz — sha256: 7f1a9c...e3c. Goal: hosted canary + dedicated sizing docs.

sara: 👍 i'll validate the tokenizer and run the usual sentencepiece->bpe checks. pinging @jen for a short customer-facing blurb.

jen: happy to draft release note. propose name 'mjolnir-2' (short) with capability bullet: "strong code generation, instruction-following; tends to be verbose with multi-turn system prompts". will include known quirks section.

matt: config checklist for eng-runtime: please confirm these keys in model-config.json before PR merge:
```
"max_sequence_length": 8192
"hidden_size": 4096
"num_attention_heads": 32
"kv_cache_layout": "[batch, layers, seq, head_dim]"
"dtype": "fp16"
```
also run: `python3 tools/validate_weights.py --s3 s3://redwood-models/mjolnir/mjolnir-2/weights.tar.gz` and paste output here.

ops-bot: deploy-check: weights archive present, uncompressed size matches manifest (14.8 GB), checksum OK. dtype=fp16. quantization candidates detected: q4_0, q4_k. autobalance disabled.

sara: tokenizer notes: mjolnir uses byte-level BPE with a custom unk token `<unk_mj>`. no explicit <pad> in vocab which breaks some batch padding paths. observed EOS merging with trailing punctuation in a few tests (e.g., "Hello!?" -> tokens where eos is glued). quick workaround: add pad token mapping and a pre-tokenizer rule to split trailing punctuation. test snippet:```python
from tokenizers import Tokenizer
t = Tokenizer.from_file('tokenizer.json')
print(t.encode('Hello!?').tokens)
```
we should add this to onboarding checklist.

matt: noted. also flag for runtime: kv cache memory estimate increases ~12% at seq=8192 vs our profiler baseline. recommend enabling memory-based autoscaling on dedicated pools for initial rollouts.

jen: draft customer-facing blurb (short):
"mjolnir-2 — open-model, 4B params, optimized for code and instruction tasks. Best for multi-step code generation and assistant flows. Known quirks: may repeat at low temperature; occasional punctuation-glued EOS in rare cases. Use recommended tokenizer patch and 8k context for best results"

matt: can someone approve PR #5423 (adds model-config, tokenizer patch, and docs)? need this merged before tomorrow's partner demo. cc @sara @jen :eyes:

jen: approved content-wise, will add small examples and a one-paragraph migration note.

deploy-bot: canary deploy started at 1791234600 for route `/models/mjolnir-2` -> mjolnir-2-hosted-v1 (10% traffic). monitor: https://console.redwood.ai/models/mjolnir-2/traces

matt: plan for fallback: if tail-latency > 95th percentile threshold or error rate spikes, auto-fallback to galileo-1 for instruction endpoints.

ops-bot: perf reminder: add a batching test with sequence lengths [128,512,2048,8192] and batch sizes [1,4,8] to capture throughput regression. Opening perf job mjolnir-2-batch-001.

sara: i'll open eval tickets for tokenizer bug + repetition regression and add them to the onboarding board. will also run the guidance tests for codegen.

matt: awesome. once PR merged i'll schedule a short customers.md entry and a microblog post draft for marketing. thanks team — will post final release timestamp here after host rollout completes.
